name: g_videoMode
notes: 0 CGA, 1 Tandy, 2 EGA (see g_biosVideoMode); set from argv[2] or detect_video()

name: g_cmpFiles
notes: struct file_entry[] (18 bytes: name, size, data, disk, pos), Westwood file-library table of the game files; empty name ends it

name: g_biosVideoMode
notes: {4, 9, 0x0D}: BIOS mode per g_videoMode (CGA 320x200x4, Tandy 320x200x16, EGA 320x200x16), passed to set_bios_mode by main

name: g_tunes
notes: 25 far pointers to the music-driver byte streams (tune_XXXX) played through snd_play

name: g_windows
notes: struct window[3] (16 bytes: x, y, w, h, fg, bg, col, row): saved text windows

name: g_scriptTable
notes: far pointers to the actor scripts (docs/SCRIPTS.md)

name: g_palettes
notes: far pointers to 16-byte palettes, one per g_cmpFiles entry

name: g_groupFirst
notes: first letter index of each of the 6 letter groups (ABCD, EFG, HIJK, LMNOP, QRSTU, VWXYZ)

name: g_sprites
notes: far pointers to sprite frames cut from the *DON/*PET sheets

name: bubble_frame
notes: operand inside scr_bubble patched by handle_key (was g_020C)

name: pick_frame1
notes: operand inside scr_pick_helper set from letter_frame (was g_021D)

name: g_curLetter
notes: letter of the current pick (0-25) (was g_145E)

name: group_intro_script
notes: g_scriptTable index of each group intro (was g_1461)

name: scr_letter_wait
notes: script for letters still on screen (init_slots) (was g_14AD)

name: pic_needs_ega
notes: per picture: draw in EGA colour mode (was g_173C)

name: g_textCols
notes: print_text wraps past this column (was g_1E86)

name: unused_1ED0
notes: unreferenced gap filler, kept for layout (was g_1ED0)

name: g_curWindow
notes: window index active in set_window (was g_1ED6)

name: g_win
notes: struct window: the active window (x, y, w, h at 1ED8, fg/bg 1EE0/1EE2, col/row 1EE4/1EE6); was win_x..win_h, g_textFg/Bg/Col/Row

name: g_windowSet
notes: 0 until set_window has run once (was g_1EE8)

name: arrow_scancodes
notes: negated scan codes up/down/left/right; unreferenced (was g_1EEA)

name: g_memReserve
notes: paragraphs kept free at startup (was g_1F38)

name: g_errSaveBuf
notes: screen save buffer for the error box (was g_1F3A)

name: g_errWindow
notes: window used by the error box (was g_1F3E)

name: g_retraceWait
notes: retraces per repeat_call tick, set by calibrate (was g_382D)

name: jump_x_major
notes: 1 = x is the major axis (was g_389C)

name: jump_major
notes: Bresenham major delta for aim/step (was g_38AE)

name: g_letterPicked
notes: 1 while a picked letter animation runs; blocks new keys (was g_38DA)

name: g_idleTicks
notes: frames without input; >5000 starts SCR_IDLE_TIMEOUT (was g_38DE)

name: g_pickedLetter
notes: letter last accepted by handle_key; indexes g_letterDone (was g_38E0)

name: unused_38E2
notes: unreferenced gap filler, kept for layout (was g_38E2)

name: g_gameWon
notes: set by next_level when all 26 letters are scored (was g_391A)

name: unused_3A9C
notes: unreferenced gap filler, kept for layout (was g_3A9C)

name: unused_3AE8
notes: unreferenced gap filler, kept for layout (was g_3AE8)

name: g_initDone
notes: set by init_game; nothing reads it in C or asm (was g_3AF0)

name: g_driveB
notes: nonzero: disks other than 0 go in drive B (select_drive; letter A+g_driveB in the insert-disk message); never set, so always A (was g_3AF6)

name: g_fixedDrive
notes: nonzero: never switch drives (hard-disk install); cleared by init_game (was g_3AFC)

name: unused_3AFE
notes: unreferenced gap filler, kept for layout (was g_3AFE)

name: g_errMsg
notes: message shown by the error hooks (was g_3B50)

name: g_diskNum
notes: disk number of the file being opened (Find_Disk_Number) (was g_3B54)

name: g_multiDisk
notes: OR of every g_cmpFiles[].disk: nonzero if any file is on another disk, so Open_File calls select_drive (was g_3B56)

name: g_fileHandles
notes: DOS handles of the resource files (was g_3B58)

name: g_preload
notes: set by main; makes load_resources read files into memory (resident) when they fit (was g_3B6C)
